conclusion: BOUNDED SEARCH COMPLETE, NO DEFINITION FOUND. Across the official public source NVIDIA open-gpu-kernel-modules tag 615.78.08 (commit 1a82fbfda8f321b056eb3568850f9316c5e465c5), the byte-identical saved copy /tmp/nvsrc, and /tmp/envytools, there is NO public bitfield definition and NO public symbolic consumer for any of the five cited TU106 topology readings: MMIO 0x00409604 (gpc_nr), MMIO 0x00502608 (tpc_nr), TPC_UNIT stride 0x504000+g*0x8000+t*0x800, fuse base+0x650, fuse base+0xc1c. dev_fuse.h (tu102) defines only two non-topology registers; dev_top.h/dev_gr.h/dev_graph.h do not exist for tu102/tu106 (dev_top.h exists only for ga100/gb100 with no topology-count fields); the only driver-side topology consumers read firmware static info via NV2080_CTRL_GR_* interfaces. Archived values (3 GPC / 5 TPC GPC0 / 17 TPC / 34 SM / 64 ROP) remain archived query claims; the only proved facts are the raw fuse values 0x0004001F (+0x650) and 0x00000038 (+0xc1c), verified against the saved fuse2.json dump. No field definitions are invented; missing evidence: TU106-applicable dev_top.h/dev_gr.h or fuse bitfield headers naming these offsets/registers.
